subject.title: Clear pending tool media delivered via the messaging tool

question: Should this PR require real delivery-path proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the source-level tests plus the failed Mantis explanation for this host/container-only duplicate-media bug?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and covered by handler tests, but the external PR has no after-fix live/log/terminal artifact and the attempted Mantis Telegram proof could not exercise the divergent path shape.

options.title: Require delivery-path proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing one generated media delivery via the message tool and no pending fallback duplicate.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly own the proof gap if the handler tests and Mantis limitation are enough for this edge case.

options.title: Narrow the dedupe key first
options.body: If basename collision risk is unacceptable, require a media-relative key or provenance-aware match before considering proof sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require delivery-path proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing one generated media delivery via the message tool and no pending fallback duplicate.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the same message-tool delivery evidence path.
